name: print-social-best-designers-poster-violet-grainy-browser-pen-tool-illustration
title: 'The Best Designers In The World Are Here!' poster with a grainy browser window and giant pen-tool illustration
whatItIs: A violet-bordered cream A4 poster with a bold two-weight headline, a browser-window frame containing a grainy purple mountain-like abstract shape with vector anchor points, and a giant yellow-pink pen tool icon overlapping the frame, closing with a black contact bar and a rotated 'Graphic Design' side label.
whatItMeans: Meta and credible; illustrating the tools of design (the pen tool, anchor points) is a clever way for a design agency to show its craft.
techniques: Illustrate the literal tools of the trade as the hero graphic.
Add grain texture to a flat illustration for tactile depth.
Rotate a category label along the poster's edge.

vocabulary.definition: A control point used to draw vector paths, shown here as a design motif.
A fine noise texture added for tactile depth.
